correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the polynomial shift u=x-b/2,w=z,h=y+b²/4+bu at a=-b²/4 and the exact system u′=-w,w′=h,h′=-h-bw-u². The transverse spectrum λ²+λ+b is stable for every b>0. Direct invariance yields W=-u²/b+2u³/b³+O(u⁴), H=-2u³/b²+O(u⁴), and R′=1+2/(bR)+O(R⁻²) for R=-b/u. This gives R=t+(2/b)log(t)+C+o(1), because the centered derivative remainder is integrable O(log(t)/t²). Bounded-orbit convergence follows Q′=-u², bounded derivatives, the stable scalar y equation; center-stable foliations give exponential tracking. Analytic argument—not symbolic finite checks—establishes all-time quantifiers. The b>0 and bounded forward-complete conditions and exceptional strong-stable set are explicit.

value.rationale: The natural first subleading correction to the sharp 1/t saddle-node decay in a canonical quadratic chaotic-flow family is a mathematically meaningful exact asymptotic invariant in original time and coordinate. Its nonzero coefficient and a convergent C remainder quantify nonlinear delay and distinguish trajectories beyond the leading law. The contribution is modest and restricted to this natural critical slice, but it is not a parameter renaming, known numerical table, or mere restatement of the earlier global theorem. No general bifurcation theorem or full attractor classification is claimed.
residual_risks: Only a model-specific refinement; significance does not extend automatically to other jerk systems.
An equivalent cubic jet calculated in unavailable literature could reduce the independent value.

limitations: Bounded forward-complete orbits only; other initial values may escape.
